name: architecture
title: Three places. One continuous conversation.
caption: Ownership map, not a network topology. The local service may run on the same Mac or a trusted SSH-connected Mac. Whisper is our custom endpoint; Kimi is managed; Firecrawl is external.

name: provenance
title: A finding keeps its chain of evidence.
caption: A concrete example: utterance U17 links to claim C4, retrieved source S1 and exact quote S1-Q2. These are illustrative labels, not actual API UUIDs. A quote establishes provenance, not infallible interpretation.

name: concurrency
title: Listening does not wait for research.
caption: Audio capture continues while ordered ASR, single-flight claim extraction and two independent research workers operate. Bar widths do not encode measured durations. Queues are bounded; failure handling is explicit.

name: versions
title: Old work cannot overwrite new state.
caption: Schematic races after successful generation changes. Pause must first drain retained audio; failed drain preserves the epoch for recovery. After epoch advance stale uploads are rejected. Claim revision changes reject obsolete research results.

name: lifecycle
title: End the meeting, not its history.
caption: Capture ends before processing ends. Finishing drains accepted audio, extraction and research. Interrupted work requires explicit recovery; opening history never starts recording.

name: persistence
title: Relationships survive; partial commits do not.
caption: A grouped relational map, not every foreign key. Meeting-scoped composite keys link immutable transcript rows to claim revisions, research and citations. Audio outcome and receipt commit atomically before local deletion.

name: boundaries
title: Model output is a proposal, not authority.
caption: The server validates transcript references, source-specific quote IDs, exact quotation spans and current session/claim versions. These gates constrain provenance and shape, not the semantic truth of all model interpretations.

name: recovery
title: Failures stop at the narrowest safe boundary.
caption: Research failures leave transcription running. Durable encrypted audio survives processing backlog; local storage exhaustion stops new intake without evicting retained chunks. Explicit recovery resumes interrupted work. These are mechanisms, not measured reliability percentages.

name: latency
title: In this run, synthesis dominated research time.
caption: Research only: excludes capture, ASR, claim extraction and UI. Not percentiles or a production benchmark. Shared zero baseline, seconds. Search and synthesis are stacked; total labels include negligible validation/rounding overhead. Source hashes and values are in measurements.json.

name: evidence-matrix
title: Evidence has scope, not a single score.
caption: Automated invariants, real-provider synthetic runs, persistence checks and resource experiments establish different properties. Their counts are not a combined accuracy or reliability percentage.
